notes: Sub-agent work becomes visible and accountable. When the assistant splits a task into parallel sub-agents, every delegation is now recorded locally and reported back to the owner: a system-generated receipt is appended to the reply (how many clones ran, how many finished, how many failed, and the tokens split between the parent turn and the clones - an unknown figure is shown as unknown, never as a guessed total), a FLEETS board in the console Stream view lists each clone with its status, and the Telegram bot gains a read-only /fleet command. Three honesty defects are fixed along the way: the operator's STOP now reaches a running sub-agent, each sub-agent gets its own share of the parent turn's context budget instead of a full copy, and an exhausted turn deadline no longer starts another sub-agent. A separate fix stops a web-console STOP from aborting an unrelated Telegram reply: the console now cancels only its own chat turn, while PAUSE stays a shared, persisted control for every surface. Clone task text is credential-linted before it is stored, the local fleet board is read-only and never returns task text, chat ids or raw errors, and no new credential or outbound path was added.
